data.narrative: The learner demonstrated exceptional mastery of production containerization by constructing a secure multi-stage Dockerfile that slashed image size to 174MB, enforced non-root execution via appuser, implemented /live and /ready health probes, and secured build context with .dockerignore.

dimension_scores.observation: Constructed multi-stage Dockerfile using Alpine 3.21 and Node 22 runtime, optimizing layer caching and pruning dev dependencies.
dimension_scores.evidence: Achieved 174MB image footprint (<200MB limit) and 0.1s cached rebuilds.

dimension_scores.observation: Separated build and runtime stages cleanly and structured build instructions for maximum cache reuse.
dimension_scores.evidence: Copied package manifests prior to dependency installation and isolated production artifacts.

dimension_scores.observation: Implemented dedicated /live and /ready endpoints returning JSON health status envelopes.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified curl HTTP 200 OK responses on /live and /ready in progress/production/module-01-verify.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Identified cache-busting layer order defects and secret leakage risks from missing .dockerignore rules.
dimension_scores.evidence: Documented full root cause analysis in progress/production/module-01-break.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Enforced non-root user execution to mitigate container breakout blast radius under compromise.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified whoami returns appuser in running container.

dimension_scores.observation: Documented complete reproducible test scripts, command outputs, and conceptual layer mechanics.
dimension_scores.evidence: Created detailed walkthrough in progress/production/module-01-verify.md and module-01-fix.md.

strengths: Demonstrated deep understanding of Docker layer mechanics and cache invalidation hierarchies.
Enforced least-privilege non-root execution (appuser) and minimal Alpine base image.
data.recommendation: Automate this build and verification process within a continuous integration pipeline in Module 02.

public_evidence.student_action: Engineered secure multi-stage production Dockerfile with non-root appuser and minimal 174MB footprint.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Multi-stage Alpine 3.21 Node 22 build with /live and /ready health probe endpoints.
public_evidence.ability: Hardening container images and optimizing build layer caching for production reliability.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Eliminates environment drift, reduces attack surface, and accelerates CI/CD build pipelines.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Separated dependency stage from runtime image in Dockerfile.
Configured user appuser and chown non-root permissions.

teaching_approaches.detail: End-to-end verification of image size, whoami non-root execution, and health probes.

learning_style_signals: Excels with concrete CLI execution feedback, reproducible container metrics, and layer inspection tools.
